title: PPAPlace: Differentiable Cross-Stage Objectives for Chip Placement Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.13790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Macro placement significantly affects a chip's post-route performance, power, and area (PPA). Most placement methods optimize half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) as the primary objective. However, recent benchmarking shows a near-zero correlation between HPWL and post-route timing metrics such as the worst negative slack (WNS) and total negative slack (TNS). As a result, all six evaluated artificial intelligence (AI) placers degraded PPA relative to the hierarchical baseline. Recent efforts have tried to train cross-stage predictors to close this gap. However, existing methods focus on macro-only representations and use pre-route metrics as training labels. A label fidelity study of ten circuits at four design flow stages reveals that HPWL and pre-route timing poorly reflect final post-route timing rankings. In contrast, post-global-routing achieves the best balance between final timing fidelity and label generation cost-effectiveness. Ba

translated_title: PPAPlace：芯片布局优化的可微分跨阶段目标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13790v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：宏单元布局显著影响芯片布线后的性能、功耗和面积（PPA）。大多数布局方法将半周长线长（HPWL）作为主要优化目标。然而，最近的基准测试显示，HPWL与布线后时序指标（如最差负松弛（WNS）和总负松弛（TNS））之间的相关性接近于零。因此，所有六个被评估的人工智能（AI）布局器相对于分层基线都导致了PPA的退化。最近的努力尝试训练跨阶段预测器来缩小这一差距。然而，现有方法仅关注宏单元表示，并使用布线前指标作为训练标签。一项对十个电路在四个设计流程阶段的标签保真度研究揭示，HPWL和布线前时序无法很好地反映最终的布线后时序排名。相比之下，全局布线后阶段在最终时序保真度和标签生成成本效益之间取得了最佳平衡。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可微分跨阶段目标方法，通过利用全局布线后阶段的高保真标签来优化芯片布局，解决了传统HPWL目标与最终布线后时序指标相关性低的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differentiable cross-stage objective method that leverages high-fidelity post-global-routing labels to optimize chip placement, addressing the low correlation between traditional HPWL objectives and final post-route timing metrics.
